snippet.title: The Scientist Battles - a narrative-driven game about the human side of science | Teaser trailer
snippet.description:
A short narrative-driven game (with shooting pipettes) about the human side of science.

Made by a scientist, this game explores the often unspoken stories behind research.

🎮 Releasing in 3 weeks on Steam
👉 Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3824280/The_Scientist_Battles/

Whether you're a scientist or someone who's ever felt lost chasing a dream, this story is for you.

#indiegame  #narrativegames  #sciencegame #lablife #labrat #scientist
